messages.english: Review seed allocations and planned pack counts.
Crop planner → Nursery requirements → Seed sourcing

Open the nursery review for saved planned batches, add the batches that can share a seed supply, and enter your allocation and seeds per pack. Review the planned requirements before downloading the CSV. Blank counts stay unknown; these inputs do not record seed stock, place an order or cover all farm seed demand.
